notes: The glosses «هو ابن سعيد بن كثير...» and «هو ابن أبي حمزة» are left out (rule 1).

The second عثمان (occurrence 2) is the Companion: the saying is his account of the Prophet's words («رأيت رسول الله ... توضأ»), so he is the last link (rule 6). The first عثمان (occurrence 1) is the transmitter after حدثنا; the two are not merged.
